scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: Stephen L. Salyer served as Co-chair of the Citizens Committee on Population and the American Future (CCPAF), an advocacy group formed after the conclusion of the United States federal Commission on Population and the American Future which had been chaired by John D. Rockefeller 3rd. The Citizens Committee sought to implement many of the Commission's recommendations and actively keep them in the broader public policy conversation regarding population.
Material documented in the collection includes vital records, correspondence, organization files, meetings, workshops and conferences, as well as select budget and finance materials.
